name: aws-k6-grocery-microservice
description: Microservice for storing grocery lists in S3 via Lambda/API Gateway, with local testing via LocalStack.

scripts.test:performance:api: docker run --rm -v $PWD:/scripts grafana/k6 run /scripts/test/performance/perf-api-gateway.js --out json=perf-api-gateway.json && ./scripts/generate-k6-html-report.sh perf-api-gateway.json perf-api-gateway-report.html
scripts.test:performance:lambda: docker run --rm -v $PWD:/scripts grafana/k6 run /scripts/test/performance/perf-lambda.js --out json=perf-lambda.json && ./scripts/generate-k6-html-report.sh perf-lambda.json perf-lambda-report.html
scripts.test:performance: npm run test:performance:api && npm run test:performance:lambda
scripts.start: localstack start -d && aws --endpoint-url=http://localhost:4566 s3 mb s3://grocery-list-bucket || true && sam local start-api --env-vars env.json
